summary: GPT-5.4 mini has no standalone OpenAI card; it is covered by an appendix to the GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card. The appendix reports strong safety scores on selected content evaluations, low CoT controllability, and a below-High determination across biological/chemical, cybersecurity, and AI self-improvement Preparedness domains.

capabilities.text: OpenAI documents GPT-5.4 mini only in the appendix, with launch-specific safety, CoT, and Preparedness measurements rather than a full system description.
The model performs strongly on dynamic mental-health simulations, including 0.985 for mental health and 0.980 for self-harm.
OpenAI says GPT-5.4 mini received full biological-risk safety training despite being classified below Bio High.
The mini model posts nontrivial cyber scores of 81.32% pass@12 on CTF and 83.33% pass@1 on CVE-Bench.
On AI self-improvement proxies, it scores 54.00% on Monorepo-Bench and 7.5% on OPQA v0.

evaluations.result: Lower controllability than any previously reported model in the suite

safety_findings.text: OpenAI classifies GPT-5.4 mini below High in Biological/Chemical, Cybersecurity, and AI self-improvement capability.
The model's CoT controllability is lower than any previously reported OpenAI model on the CoT-Control suite, which OpenAI treats as favorable for monitorability risk.
OpenAI uses GPT-5 physical-world novice-uplift evidence plus automated benchmark comparisons to conclude GPT-5.4 mini does not cross the Bio High threshold.
GPT-5.4 mini received full biological-risk safety training even though it is below Bio High.
The appendix reports substantial cyber proxy scores but still leaves the model below High cybersecurity capability.

limitations.text: There is no standalone GPT-5.4 mini card; the appendix is narrower than a full system card.
The physical-world novice-uplift evidence cited for biology concerns GPT-5 and is applied to GPT-5.4 mini through comparison rather than direct physical testing of the mini model.
Refusal-inclusive biology scores are conservative capability estimates and should not be read as observed task completion.
The appendix omits many broader capability and safety evaluations reported for GPT-5.4 Thinking, including HealthBench, prompt injection, destructive-action avoidance, and Cyber Range.
The reported cyber evidence is limited to CTF and CVE-Bench in the appendix, while OpenAI's domain determination remains below High.

practical_implications.text: Use GPT-5.4 mini for quicker routine coding work when a smaller reasoning model is enough.
Do not import GPT-5.4 Thinking's main-body benchmark results into expectations for the mini model.
Review generated code and shell actions carefully because the appendix does not report destructive-action safeguards for this model.
Keep security use authorized and defensive despite the below-High cyber determination.
Treat the appendix as a limited safety snapshot, not a complete operating manual for the model.

coverage_notes: This digest is limited to the GPT-5.4 mini appendix on pages 33-36 of the GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card. Main-body GPT-5.4 Thinking results are sibling-model evidence and are not attributed to GPT-5.4 mini.
